_doc: Config Q = pure model (user 12/11: keep only data reading / schema (ingest, automap) and the business toolkit (dm, industry); no rule-read hints in the prompt, example retrieval by the question text only, no rule prechecks / flags / review / format fix). Same sampling as O: full prompt, 2 -> 8 samples, round 2 think, 1536-token cap, vote, abstain < 0.5. The toolkit's own API checks (syntax, unknown name, keyword, value not in the data) and execution errors stay as feedback.
